paper.title_en: Noncommutative Scalar Quasinormal Modes in Static de Sitter Spacetime
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a scalar field in a static de Sitter spacetime within the framework of noncommutative geometry. Using the Moyal star-product and the Seiberg-Witten map to first order in the noncommutativity parameter $\theta $, the corresponding equation of motion is reduced to a Schrödinger-type equation with an effective Pöschl-Teller potential. Then, the QNM spectrum is obtained analytically. We have shown that the noncommutativity breaks rotational symmetry and lifts the degeneracy with respect to the magnetic quantum number m. Moreover, we have studied the temporal evolution of scalar perturbations. It is shown how the noncommutativity modifies the amplitude of the signal leading to either enhanced or suppressed damping, depending on the sign of $m\theta H$.
